title: ZS Salovnova
description: zssalounova.cz ZŠ Šalounova is a primary school located in the Vítkovice district of Ostrava, Czech Republic, operating across two buildings on Šalounova and Halasova streets. The institution provides comprehensive standard education alongside specialized programs, a wide range of extracurricular clubs, and a full school counseling facility. It actively supports student success through dedicated staff, including school psychologists, special educators, and career counselors, as well as various educational and sports projects.
